usage: agentware kb-git [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    status          report is_work_tree / has_upstream / is_clean for the KB
                    repo
    commit          stage + commit ONLY the KB repo as one feat|chore(tag):
                    commit
    pull            fast-forward the KB repo from upstream at a safe point
                    (no-op when dirty / offline / no upstream)
    push            push KB commits to upstream, auto-resolving derived-file
                    conflicts via index rebuild (no-op when offline / no
                    upstream)
    merge-continue  continue a paused prose-merge rebase after the entry files
                    were reconciled, rebuild derived files, then push

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
